descriptor: Electric commuter bikes with long range

voice.summary: Voltage Cycles speaks the way a good bike shop mechanic sells: big on range, honest about weight and charge time. Specs come as numbers with units and a punchy headline.
dos: Pair every claim with a figure and a unit
Keep headlines to six words or fewer
Use active verbs like go, charge and ride

boilerplate: Voltage Cycles builds electric commuter bikes such as the V2, with 120 km of real-world range, a four-hour full charge and a 16.8 kg frame.
